$comment: Expectation manifest for the WebMCP surface (src/lib/webmcp/). Checked by hand against a running editor at /app — see the WebMCP section of CLAUDE.md. Every tool must be discovered; only read-only and reversible cases carry an `input` and get invoked. Nothing consumes this automatically.

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.$comment: Discovery-only: needs WebGL and a selected node, and returns a multi-megabyte data URL. Covered by e2e, not by an invocation here.

tools.name: batch_design
tools.$comment: Reversible: creates a node in the open document, undoable by the user. Only ever invoked against a scratch canvas.

tools.name: get_style_guide_tags
tools.$comment: Discovery-only by default: reaches the backend, so an invocation needs a backend running.

tools.name: get_style_guide
tools.$comment: Discovery-only by default, same backend dependency as get_style_guide_tags.

readOnlyCanvas.$comment: On /c/:shareId and on /app?view the mutating tools must not be published at all, and must refuse if editability changes after registration.
